bbb.title: Big Buck Bunny (2008 original)
bbb.note: NOT the 2013 Sunflower re-release, which runs ~40s longer. The YouTube upload the heatmap comes from is 597s, matching the original at 596.5s. Using Sunflower would shift every timecode and fail silently.

sintel.title: Sintel
sintel.note: Blender hosts only a 1.1GB 1080p mkv for this one, and that download died twice at ~500MB. The archive.org mirror of the Blender release is 270MB and arrived in a minute. Its 74MB sibling is NOT usable despite being named 2048: it decodes at 564x240, and cutting 360p clips from it would mean upscaling Sintel while tos and bbb are downscaled from 1280 and 853 - a picture-quality difference between films, in the one comparison the third film exists to make. Duration 888.064s matches the heatmap's 888s.
